package.name: aav_lane_follower_rs
package.description: control_interface in Rust (rclrs): the lane follower on twist_mux's AI slot, a drop-in for aav_lane_geometry's Python node (the 2025-26 team's), the default since 19 Nov (lane_follower_impl:=python falls back). The same node name, topics, QoS, parameters, states and commands; steering:= adds the challengers, pure pursuit and Stanley on the fitted lane centre, with the car's lag. The logic is the lane-follow-core crate, with no ROS, checked against lane_follow.py's answers.
